title: Conestructor track (.cone), version 1
description: One autocross track: its targets and cones in metres in the export frame, Conestructor's own editable design, and the lot photo. See docs/cone-format.md. Readers ignore fields they do not know.

version.description: 1 for this structure; changes only when the structure changes.

name.description: The track's name (the file name when saved).

app.description: The app and version that saved it.

saved.description: When it was saved, ISO 8601 UTC.

axes.description: x toward Direction target, y to the left, heading degrees counter-clockwise from +x

direction.description: On +x; null until Origin, Direction and the ruler's real length are set.

cones.description: Every cone in driving order; empty when the track cannot be processed yet.

design.description: Conestructor's own editable track. It may change between app versions: read cones instead.

heading.description: Degrees counter-clockwise from +x: where a leaning cone points; 0 for standing cones.

element.description: The element that made it; null for a cone added by hand.

edited.description: Optional: true when someone changed this cone by hand.
